title: Hydrostatic Force on a Submerged Vertical Rectangular Plate
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A vertical rectangular floodgate 4 m wide and 3 m high has its top edge submerged 2 m below the surface of water (density 9800 N/m^3). Find the total hydrostatic fluid force on the gate.

steps.title: Set Coordinate System for Depth
steps.mathExpression: h \text{ runs from } 2 \text{ to } 5 \text{ meters}; \quad w(h) = 4 \text{ m}
steps.explanation: Top edge at depth 2 m, bottom edge at depth 2 + 3 = 5 m.

steps.title: Formulate Incremental Force
steps.mathExpression: dF = \text{Pressure} \cdot dA = (\rho g h) \cdot (w \, dh) = 9800 \cdot h \cdot 4 \, dh = 39200 h \, dh
steps.explanation: Pressure = rho * g * h, area = width * dh.
